episodes.title: Fleetwood Mac Lost Three Guitarists in Three Years. One Joined a Cult. One Ended Up Homeless.| Vol.2
episodes.description:
Between 1970 and 1972, Fleetwood Mac lost three lead guitarists in three years.

Peter Green — the founder — walked away and gave everything away. Jeremy Spencer vanished into a religious cult in Los Angeles and never came back. Danny Kirwan smashed his guitar backstage, was fired, and spent decades homeless on the streets of London.

Any one of these would have ended any other band. Fleetwood Mac survived all three — because Mick Fleetwood and John McVie refused to stop, Christine McVie held the centre, and Bob Welch reinvented the sound.

This is the part of the Fleetwood Mac story nobody tells. The forgotten middle chapter between Peter Green and Stevie Nicks.

The Fleetwood Mac Files, Vol.2. Next: Lindsey and Stevie walk through the door.
